summary.text: Kadyn Wittman is a Democratic state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 15 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She faces Republicans Joni Tschetter and Andre Zachariahs, along with fellow Democrat June CopperStad, for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Kadyn Wittman earned a B.A. in sociology and women's studies from Augustana University in 2013, according to Ballotpedia.

Her career experience includes serving as director of development of the Sioux Falls Family YMCA, director of marketing and development of the Multi-Cultural Center of Sioux Falls, and a case manager with Bishop Dudley Hospitality House.
Wittman took office on January 10, 2023, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the House Agriculture and Natural Resources and Local Government committees.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she had worked on community causes for more than ten years, serves on several Sioux Falls nonprofit boards, and supports equal protection regardless of gender identity and sexual orientation and access to safe and affordable health care.
